fn main() -> i32 {
    println("=== GUM-Compliant Measurement Uncertainty ===")
    println("")

    // TYPE-B UNCERTAINTY: Certified Reference Standard
    // Value: 100.0 µg/mL ± 0.5% (rectangular distribution)
    println("Type-B Uncertainty (Reference Standard):")
    let ref_value = 100.0
    let rel_unc = 0.005  // 0.5%
    let abs_unc = ref_value * rel_unc

    // Rectangular distribution: variance = a²/3
    let variance_b = (abs_unc * abs_unc) / 3.0
    let reference = epistemic_new(ref_value, variance_b)

    println("  Value: 100.0 µg/mL")
    println("  Certificate: ± 0.5%")
    print("  Variance (a²/3): ")
    println(variance_b)
    print("  Std dev: ")
    println(epistemic_std(reference))
    println("")

    // Verify rectangular formula
    let expected_rect = (abs_unc * abs_unc) / 3.0
    if abs_f64(variance_b - expected_rect) < 0.0001 {
        println("  PASS: Rectangular variance = a²/3")
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: Variance calculation error")
    }
    println("")

    // TYPE-A UNCERTAINTY: Sample Measurements
    // Five measurements: mean = 98.3, std = 0.158
    println("Type-A Uncertainty (Repeated Measurements):")
    let m1 = 98.2
    let m2 = 98.5
    let m3 = 98.1
    let m4 = 98.4
    let m5 = 98.3

    let mean_meas = (m1 + m2 + m3 + m4 + m5) / 5.0

    // Sample variance
    let d1 = m1 - mean_meas
    let d2 = m2 - mean_meas
    let d3 = m3 - mean_meas
    let d4 = m4 - mean_meas
    let d5 = mean_meas - mean_meas

    let sum_sq = d1*d1 + d2*d2 + d3*d3 + d4*d4 + d5*d5
    let s_sq = sum_sq / 4.0  // n-1

    // Standard error: s/√n
    let se = sqrt_f64(s_sq) / sqrt_f64(5.0)
    let variance_a = se * se

    let measured = epistemic_new(mean_meas, variance_a)

    println("  Measurements: [98.2, 98.5, 98.1, 98.4, 98.3]")
    print("  Mean: ")
    println(mean_meas)
    print("  Std error (s/√n): ")
    println(se)
    print("  Variance: ")
    println(variance_a)
    println("")

    // RECOVERY CALCULATION
    println("Recovery Factor:")
    let recovery = epistemic_div(measured, reference)

    print("  Value: ")
    println(recovery.value * 100.0)
    println("  %")
    print("  Std uncertainty: ")
    println(epistemic_std(recovery) * 100.0)
    println("  %")

    // Expanded uncertainty (k=2)
    let k = 2.0
    let expanded = k * epistemic_std(recovery) * 100.0

    print("  Expanded (k=2): ± ")
    println(expanded)
    println("  %")
    println("")

    // UNCERTAINTY BUDGET
    println("Uncertainty Budget:")

    // Variance contributions
    let ref_sq = reference.value * reference.value
    let ref_sq_sq = ref_sq * ref_sq
    let contrib_ref = measured.value * measured.value * reference.variance / ref_sq_sq
    let contrib_meas = measured.variance / ref_sq

    let total_var = recovery.variance
    let pct_ref = contrib_ref / total_var * 100.0
    let pct_meas = contrib_meas / total_var * 100.0

    print("  Type-B (Reference): ")
    println(pct_ref)
    println("  %")
    print("  Type-A (Measurement): ")
    println(pct_meas)
    println("  %")
    println("")

    // Verification
    let sum_contrib = contrib_ref + contrib_meas
    let budget_error = abs_f64(sum_contrib - total_var)

    if budget_error < 0.000001 {
        println("  PASS: Uncertainty budget complete")
    } else {
        println("  FAIL: Budget error")
    }
    println("")

    println("=== GUM Report ===")
    println("")
    print("Recovery: ")
    println(recovery.value * 100.0)
    println("  %")
    print("Expanded Uncertainty: ± ")
    println(expanded)
    println("  % (k=2, ~95%)")
    println("")
    println("Traceability: NIST-traceable standard")
    println("Compliance: ISO/IEC 17025, GUM (2008)")

    return 0
}

    // Distribution: Rectangular (no information about where in ±0.5% it lies)
    println("Step 1: Certified Reference Standard (Type-B)")
    let standard_value = 100.0
    let standard_rel_unc = 0.005  // 0.5% = 0.005

    let standard = type_b_uncertainty(standard_value, standard_rel_unc)

    println("  Value: 100.0 µg/mL")
    println("  Certificate uncertainty: ± 0.5% (k=2)")
    println("  Distribution: Rectangular")
    print("  Variance: ")
    println(standard.variance)

    println(epistemic_std(standard))
    println("")

    // Verify rectangular distribution variance
    let a = standard_value * standard_rel_unc
    let expected_var_rect = (a * a) / 3.0
    println("  Verification (Rectangular Distribution):")
    print("    Half-width a: ")

    print("    Expected var (a²/3): ")
    println(expected_var_rect)
    print("    Actual variance: ")
    println(standard.variance)

    if abs_f64(standard.variance - expected_var_rect) < 0.0001 {
        println("    PASS: Variance = a²/3")
    } else {
        println("    FAIL: Incorrect variance calculation")
    }
    println("")

    // SAMPLE MEASUREMENTS (Type-A)
    // Analyst measures sample 5 times (n=5)
    // Results: [98.2, 98.5, 98.1, 98.4, 98.3] µg/mL
    println("Step 2: Sample Measurements (Type-A)")
    println("  Measurements (n=5): [98.2, 98.5, 98.1, 98.4, 98.3] µg/mL")

    let sample = type_a_uncertainty(98.2, 98.5, 98.1, 98.4, 98.3)

    print("  Mean: ")

    println("  µg/mL")
    print("  Std error (s/√n): ")
    println(epistemic_std(sample))
    println("  µg/mL")
    print("  Variance: ")
    println(sample.variance)

    // RECOVERY FACTOR CALCULATION
    // Recovery = Sample / Standard
